# Pokemon Mechanics

## Overview

The pure mechanics module calculates displayed stats, selects ability and Mega previews, derives Hidden Power from IVs, and plans IV changes. The spread model enforces editable values; the card, stat table, toolbar, and dialogs present the results. Work from the shared rules before changing their UI callers. The stored spread species and ability slot do not change when previewing a Mega Evolution.

## Files

- [pokemon-mechanics.mjs](../../../shared/pokemon-mechanics.mjs) owns `STATS`, `IV_FIELDS`, `EV_FIELDS`, `MAX_IV`, `MAX_EV`, `MAX_EV_TOTAL`, `EV_STEP`, `LITTLE_CUP_LEVEL`, `PREVIEW_LEVELS`, `DEFAULT_PREVIEW_LEVEL`, `ABILITY_SLOTS`, `MOVE_HIDDEN_POWER`, `HIDDEN_POWER_TYPES`, and `STAT_USE`. Its exports are `getNatureEffect(nature)`, `calculateStat({ stat, baseStat, iv, ev, level, nature, species })`, `calculateStats(species, baseStats, fields, level)`, `getMegaSpecies(catalog, fields)`, `calculateSpreadStats(catalog, fields, { level, mega = true })`, `getSpreadLevel(set, previewLevel)`, `getEvTotal(fields)`, `getMaxEv(fields, stat)`, and `stepEv(fields, stat, direction, littleCup = null)`.
- [pokemon-mechanics.mjs](../../../shared/pokemon-mechanics.mjs) also exports `getAbilityLabel(slot)`, `getAbilityOptions(speciesInfo)`, `getEffectiveAbility(speciesInfo, slot)`, `getMegaAbility(catalog, fields)`, `getHiddenPowerType(ivs)`, `optimizeHiddenPowerIvs(ivs, type)`, `getMoveStatUse(move, details)`, `getSpreadStatUse(catalog, moves)`, `isSlowSpeedSpread(fields, teamTypes = [])`, `getIvAutoFix(catalog, fields, teamTypes = [])`, `getResetIvs(catalog, fields, teamTypes = [])`, and `planIvAutoFix(catalog, spreads, teamTypes = [])`.
- [spread-suggestions.mjs](../../../shared/spread-suggestions.mjs) exports `SPREAD_PRESETS` and `getSuggestedSpread(catalog, fields, { level, preset = null, teamTypes = [] })`, a pure Showdown-inspired role heuristic returning `{ role, fields }` with only all six EVs, all six IVs and nature, or `null` when safe data is unavailable. A null preset infers the role; a preset name selects explicit stat/nature priorities.
- [spread-model.mjs](../../../shared/spread-model.mjs) uses the mechanics constants and helpers in `validateSpreadFields(fields)`, `setEv(fields, stat, value)`, `setIv(fields, stat, value)`, `setMove(fields, slot, move, hiddenPowerType = null)`, and `createNewSpreadFields(species, speciesInfo)`. A typed Hidden Power choice optimizes all six IVs; a new spread starts with 31 IVs, zero EVs, and the first available ability slot in `[1]`, `[2]`, `[H]` order (or slot 1 if none is listed).
- [SpreadStats.jsx](../../../src/subcomponents/SpreadStats.jsx) shows base stats, EVs, IVs, final stats while editing, nature arrows, EV budget, steppers, and the Reset EVs and Reset IVs heading buttons. It passes the Little Cup species, displayed base stats, and level to `stepEv`.
- [SpreadCard.jsx](../../../src/components/SpreadCard.jsx) chooses the preview level, Mega species and ability, ability labels and edit options, and the per-card Mega Stats switch. Its editing card is shown in [SpreadDialogs.jsx](../../../src/components/SpreadDialogs.jsx).
- [SpreadFilters.jsx](../../../src/components/SpreadFilters.jsx) provides the Lv. 50/Lv. 100 preview control and the Auto-Fix toolbar button. [SpreadEditorPage.jsx](../../../src/SpreadEditorPage.jsx) uses `openAutoFix` to plan changes with `planSpreadAutoFix` for filtered editable spreads from current drafts or saved fields. [SpreadEditorState.jsx](../../../src/SpreadEditorState.jsx) applies the proposed field changes to drafts on confirmation.
- [spread-model.mjs](../../../shared/spread-model.mjs) owns `compactMoves(fields)`, `getSpreadAutoFix(catalog, fields, teamTypes = [])`, `planSpreadAutoFix(catalog, spreads, category = AUTO_FIX_CATEGORY.ALL, teamTypes = [])`, `AUTO_FIX_CATEGORY` and `MOVE_REMOVAL`. The combined auto-fix brings IVs over 31 down to 31, repairs EV caps, removes illegal, undefined and repeated moves, shifts remaining moves up, then applies `getIvAutoFix` to the result. `getSpreadAutoFix` retains its combined `fields` and adds independent `categoryFields: { moves, ivs, evs }` plus `categoryIvFix`. IV-only changes cap IVs before computing against current moves, including moves that All would remove. `planSpreadAutoFix` selects the category's fields and IV context, and includes unknown-stat skips only for All and IVs. `compactMoves` also runs when editing ends and before a new spread is added.
- [SpreadDialogs.jsx](../../../src/components/SpreadDialogs.jsx) presents `AutoFixDialog` with bulleted changes, skipped stats, and a collapsed locked-spread accordion before Apply. Its `AutoFixList` reuses `useIncrementalList` from [CatalogDisplay.jsx](../../../src/subcomponents/CatalogDisplay.jsx). [MovePicker.jsx](../../../src/subcomponents/MovePicker.jsx) exposes typed Hidden Power choices that feed the spread model.

## Rules

### Final stats, levels, and natures

- Stat keys are `hp`, `atk`, `def`, `spAtk`, `spDef`, `spd`; `spd` means Speed. For each stat, calculate `base = floor((2 * baseStat + iv + floor(ev / 4)) * level / 100)`. HP is `base + level + 10`; non-HP stats start at `base + 5` and apply `floor(value * 110 / 100)` for a raised nature or `floor(value * 90 / 100)` for a lowered nature. Nature does not modify HP. Shedinja HP is always 1, even without a known base stat. Other missing base stats yield `null` and display as `?`.
- `getNatureEffect` uses CFRU's 25-nature order, grouping five lowered stats for each raised stat. The stat order is Attack, Defense, Speed, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def. Same raised/lowered stat means a neutral nature with both fields `null`; an unknown nature returns `null`. The stat table uses red up arrows for raised stats and blue down arrows for lowered stats; the nature picker labels non-neutral effects.
- `PREVIEW_LEVELS` is `[50, 100]`, default 50. `getSpreadLevel(set, previewLevel)` overrides the chosen level with 5 for a set with `littleCup`; view cards show their Lv. 5 badge. Little Cup edit cards instead show an enabled-by-default Level 5 switch in the Total-row footer. Turning it off previews at the page's current level and uses normal EV stepping; turning it on restores level 5 and Little Cup stepping. This local preview does not change fields or the effective Showdown exchange level. `calculateSpreadStats` uses the selected species' base stats and returns `{ species, mega, stats }` without changing the spread fields.

### EV and IV limits and stepping

- `MAX_IV = 31`, `MAX_EV = 252`, `MAX_EV_TOTAL = 510`, `EV_STEP = 4`. `getEvTotal` sums all six EV fields; `getMaxEv(fields, stat)` is `max(0, min(252, 510 - (total EVs - this stat's EVs)))`. `setIv` clamps whole-number entries to its limits; `setEv` retains nonnegative integer entries above legal caps and clamps negatives to zero. Both ignore non-integers. Typed illegal EVs receive red feedback, but arrows retain legal caps and validation blocks saving invalid drafts. Entered EVs need not be divisible by 4.
- Ordinary EV arrows go to the next or previous multiple of 4, bounded by the per-stat and total limits. They return `null` when no step is possible. Without a known Little Cup base stat, arrows use this ordinary behavior, except Shedinja HP can still be evaluated.
- For Little Cup with known base stats, `stepEv` checks the actual final stat at level 5 (or the supplied Little Cup level). Raising chooses the first multiple of 4 that increases the final stat within the budget. Lowering chooses the smallest EV investment that reaches the next lower final stat. If lower EVs cannot change the stat, lowering clears them to 0. Nature rounding can skip a stat value; Shedinja HP cannot be raised by EVs. Both arrow buttons and EV input arrow keys use this step; IV steppers change by 1.
- Reset EVs sets all six EVs to 0; its button is disabled when the total is already 0. The stat table shows the total in view mode, or the remaining budget / amount over 510 in edit mode.
- Auto-Fix first caps integer EVs above 252 at 252. If the total still exceeds 510, it exhausts the smallest positive non-maxed investment first, then the next smallest, and touches maxed stats only when needed. Equal investments use `STATS` order: HP, Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed. Each reduction removes only the outstanding excess, bounded by the investment. This also applies to Little Cup: legal entered EVs need not be multiples of 4, so Auto-Fix does not use arrow stepping or round otherwise legal investments.

### Abilities and Mega Evolution

- CFRU ability slots are `HIDDEN: 0`, `FIRST: 1`, `SECOND: 2`. `getAbilityOptions` lists non-null slots in `[1]`, `[2]`, `[H]` order, retaining separate options when abilities have the same name. `getAbilityLabel` returns the slot marker or an empty string for an unknown slot. `getEffectiveAbility` reads the selected slot, falling back to the first ability when that slot is empty, then to `null`.
- `getMegaSpecies` takes the first available Mega evolution from catalog matches for the spread species, item, and moves whose Mega species exists in the catalog. For `SPECIES_ZYGARDE` and `SPECIES_ZYGARDE_10` with effective ability `ABILITY_POWERCONSTRUCT` and `ITEM_ZYGARDITE`, it follows `SPECIES_ZYGARDE_COMPLETE`'s catalog Mega link. The stored base species and ability slot remain unchanged, and disabling Mega Stats returns to that stored species' stats. `getMegaAbility` returns `{ species, ability }` using the selected slot on that species with the first-slot fallback, or `null` without a Mega. Cards show the base ability and a separate `[M]` Mega ability; edit-mode options include a right-arrow transition to `[M]` when the abilities differ, for example `[H] Chlorophyll -> [M] Thick Fat` (the UI renders a right-arrow glyph). A Mega's stats use its base stats when `mega` is true, which is the default for `calculateSpreadStats`.
- Each card owns a `showMega` toggle initialized to true. The Mega Stats switch appears in edit mode only when a Mega ability exists and changes the displayed stat preview, not the saved species or ability slot. The card passes the currently shown species and base stats to the stat table for Little Cup EV stepping.

### Hidden Power

- `HIDDEN_POWER_TYPES` contains 16 types in formula order: Fighting, Flying, Poison, Ground, Rock, Bug, Ghost, Steel, Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Psychic, Ice, Dragon, Dark. Normal and Fairy are excluded. `getHiddenPowerType` takes the low bit of each IV in the order HP, Attack, Defense, Speed, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def. With weights `1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32`, the type index is `floor(paritySum * 15 / 63)`.
- `optimizeHiddenPowerIvs(ivs, type)` returns all six IVs or `null` for an unsupported type. It tries all 64 parity masks, chooses the closest IV of the required parity (0/1 stay low, others stay high), and keeps only masks producing the requested type. Candidate costs compare lexicographically: positive Speed IV loss, total positive IV loss, number of changed IVs, deviations from Showdown's standard even-IV pattern for that type, then sacrifice weights `atkIv: 1`, `spAtkIv: 2`, `defIv: 4`, `spDefIv: 8`, `hpIv: 16`, `spdIv: 32`. The last criterion prefers losing less important stats. An already matching IV stays unchanged; a nonmaximal IV can increase by 1 to change parity. When choosing a typed Hidden Power move, `setMove` applies these six IVs.

### Move use and IV auto-fix

- `STAT_USE` is `used`, `unused`, or `unknown`. `getMoveStatUse(move, details)` marks empty slots unused and moves without details or a split unknown. Status moves, Foul Play (target's Attack), Body Press (user's Defense), and the listed fixed-damage effects use neither of the user's attacking stats. Photon Geyser, Light That Burns The Sky, and Shell Side Arm use both because their damage category can change. Other physical moves use Attack, special moves use Sp. Atk; variable power alone does not mean fixed damage. Missing or zero power, or variable power with no known effect, leaves the relevant attacking stat unknown. `getSpreadStatUse` combines move results per attacking stat: `used` wins over `unknown`, which wins over `unused`.
- `getIvAutoFix` lowers unused Attack and Sp. Atk IVs to 0, or 1 if Hidden Power needs odd parity. It also lowers Speed when `isSlowSpeedSpread` finds Gyro Ball, Trick Room, or the Doubles Trick Room team, even without a slow move. Symbolic `specificTeamType === "DOUBLES_TRICK_ROOM_TEAM"` works without context; numeric integer values resolve against the optional snapshot `teamTypes: [{ name, value }]`. Unmatched numbers and unresolved enum values are not slow-team evidence. Never hardcode a numeric enum value. It raises used attacking IVs below 31 to 31, or 30 if Hidden Power needs even parity; unknown attacking stats stay unchanged. When Hidden Power is among the moves, it searches joint 0/1 or 31/30 targets and rejects combinations that change the current Hidden Power type. It minimizes total distance from those target extremes, breaking a tie toward lower Attack when Attack is being lowered. Only Attack, Sp. Atk, and sometimes Speed are auto-fixed; other IVs stay untouched.
- The game catalog does not contain the team enum. `SpreadCard` passes snapshot `teamTypes` to suggestion preview and current-field reapplication, and to `SpreadStats` for both reset availability and current-field reset. `SpreadEditorPage` passes `spreads.teamTypes` into every categorized bulk plan. Shared APIs default this context to `[]`; they never normalize saved team fields or include context in returned changes.
- `getIvAutoFix` returns `{ changes, uses, unknown, hiddenPowerIvs }`. `changes` contains only IV fields with new values. `unknown` names attacking stats left alone due to unknown move details. `hiddenPowerIvs` contains only changed fields left off their ideal extreme for Hidden Power. `planIvAutoFix(catalog, spreads, teamTypes = [])` collects `{ id, fields, hiddenPowerIvs }` for spreads with changes and `{ id, stats }` for spreads with unknown attacking stats; one spread can occur in both lists.
- `getResetIvs` starts all six IVs at 31. When the moves include Hidden Power, it first optimizes these six IVs to preserve the spread's current type, then runs auto-fix on the reset values. Thus unused attacking IVs and Speed IVs for slow moves or a Doubles Trick Room team can end at 0/1, used attacking IVs at 31/30, and other IVs at the Hidden Power-compatible high values. The Reset IVs heading button applies these six values and is disabled when they already match.
- The toolbar's Auto-Fix button opens the Auto-Fix Spreads preview for every currently filtered spread across all pages, using drafts where present and excluding non-editable spreads from changes. Both `openAutoFix` and `planSpreadAutoFix` exclude entries with `placeholder: true` entirely, regardless of editability; they do not appear in any count, change, skipped-stat list or locked accordion. `openAutoFix` builds separate plans and passes `categoryChanges` and `categorySkipped` keyed by category, retaining categorized `descriptions: { moves: string[], ivs: string[], evs: string[] }` and locked `{ id, label, reason }` entries. `applyAutoFix(category)` applies only that plan to drafts, closes the dialog and reports a toast such as `Fixed IVs in 5 spreads.` Cancel changes nothing.
- Each description is a short action bullet: `Removing unlearnable/undefined/repeated move X`, `Shifting moves up over a blank slot`, `Lowering/Raising STAT IV OLD to NEW`, `Lowering STAT EVs OLD to NEW`, or `Keeping STAT IV unchanged (unknown move details)`. A changed field held odd or even for Hidden Power keeps its `(kept odd/even for Hidden Power)` annotation, including single-change entries.
- `AutoFixDialog` starts with one brief sentence covering moves, IVs and EVs for all matching spreads on every page. Its All, Moves, IVs and EVs tabs count affected spreads, not bullets; zero-count category tabs are omitted unless already selected. All shows the combined plan's bullets, while each category shows its independent preview and skipped stats. The confirmation labels are Apply All, Apply Moves, Apply IVs and Apply EVs; confirmation passes the selected category and is disabled when that category has no changes. Selected tabs and their indicator use `FOCUS_TABS`, and the skipped-stat list stays below the tabs. Its small How Auto-Fix Works icon button opens an MUI tooltip on hover, keyboard focus or click. Detailed rules are ten short bullet lines, including EV caps and reduction priorities, with tooltip width capped at 360px through `slotProps`. The installed MUI v9 icon package exports the outlined HelpOutline icon as `HelpOutlineOutlined`.
- Auto-Fix lists start with `LIST_PAGE_SIZE` entries and load another batch when their own scroll container approaches the bottom, with no truncated remainder text. Switching category tabs remounts the changed-spread list with a fresh batch; skipped and locked lists keep their existing incremental behavior. [SpreadEditorPage.css](../../../src/styles/SpreadEditorPage.css) bounds these lists to 40vh and keeps the surrounding dialog content scrollable. Export's separate `PreviewList` retains its existing 200-entry limit.
- The locked accordion starts collapsed and counts only non-placeholder, non-editable matching spreads. Expanding it explains unsafe source rewriting and shows an incremental list of source labels, the unsafe-source explanation and available entry diagnostics. Neither its explanation nor its entries mention placeholders. The server locks unsupported initializers, repeated field designators, unsupported move lists or field expressions, and files with unresolved preprocessing or syntax errors. Unknown fields alone are preserved, not necessarily locked.

## User decisions

- Edit mode has a right-aligned split button beside optional trainer chips, labelled with nature and nonzero EV distribution using short stat labels in stat-table order on one row, with the role in an MUI tooltip. The separate arrow opens a searchable preset-name autocomplete, including Automatic Suggestion. Selecting an option immediately applies EVs, IVs and nature to the current draft; the main button can reapply it. Both paths preserve unrelated fields and source-omitted nature through `setFieldSymbol`; neither saves. Searching or cancelling changes nothing. Unavailable proposals show disabled No Suggested Spread. Suggestions always use battle-effective Mega stats/ability and the set's battle level, independently of Mega Stats and Level 5 preview switches.
- Nine presets cover Fast/Bulky/Slow Physical/Special Attacker, Physically/Specially Defensive and Fast Bulky Support. Every dropdown option is always selectable, including with empty/unknown moves, wrong attacking category or conflicting slow moves. Explicit priorities override move compatibility: attacking presets invest and maximize their primary attack, non-slow presets retain their EV/IV priorities even with slow moves or a Doubles Trick Room team, and slow presets minimize Speed. Nature selection is separate: Gyro Ball, Trick Room or the symbolic Doubles Trick Room team always requires a Speed-lowering nature, including for fast presets. Fast attacking presets then boost their primary attack; Fast Bulky Support prefers Defense. Synthetic moves and team context supply IV-only priorities without changing saved moves, team requirements or Hidden Power type. A safe catalog nature fallback is allowed if the desired boost is absent, but an actual slow move/team condition requires the fallback to lower Speed or the proposal is unavailable. Explicit slow presets without that condition retain their safe incomplete-catalog fallback. Missing base stats/invalid IVs for Hidden Power still prevent applying a proposal. Unknown names return null. Automatic Suggestion retains the stricter move-based inference. Opening the chooser focuses and selects the entire preset text so immediate typing replaces it.
- Suggestions accept one to four known moves (unlike Showdown's usual four-move requirement). Unknown move use, missing base stats, empty moves or no safe catalog nature disable the button. Role inference considers attack use, setup, Choice items, speed abilities, recovery/stall, Body Press, slow-Speed moves and the symbolic Doubles Trick Room team requirement. It is a starting point, not a literal Showdown port or matchup optimizer; weather abilities assume their weather and no species-specific speed benchmarks or HP rounding are imposed. Fast offense boosts Speed unless already speed-boosted; bulky offense invests HP and attack; defensive sets invest HP and defense. Mixed natures never lower a used attacking stat. In automatic suggestions, Trick Room/Gyro Ball or a Doubles Trick Room team override inferred fast choices, lower Speed nature, minimize Speed IVs and receive no Speed EVs. Explicit presets retain the separate EV/IV override described above.
- Suggested IVs reuse `getResetIvs`, preserving every Hidden Power type. EVs stay within 252 per stat and a useful 508 total, in multiples of four; level/nature plateaus are trimmed and spare EVs buy only measurable stat gains. Below level 20, bulky HP second investment is replaced by the weaker defense. Shedinja receives no HP/Defense/Sp. Def EVs.
- Preserve the user's chosen preview level for ordinary sets; Little Cup defaults to level 5 but its edit-footer switch allows the page level instead. Default to Mega stats when a Mega is available, without changing the spread. Mega Stats and Level 5 are independent local preview switches.
- Preserve distinct ability slots even when they name the same ability, and show the Mega ability separately. Missing chosen slots fall back to the first ability.
- Keep an attacking IV for a variable-power move with a known damage effect. Foul Play does not require the user's Attack, and Body Press does not require the user's Attack or Sp. Atk. Unknown move details must not trigger a speculative change to an attacking IV.
- Reset IVs and Auto-Fix minimize Speed to 0 for Gyro Ball, Trick Room or a symbolic or enum-resolved numeric Doubles Trick Room team when Hidden Power permits it, otherwise use 1 when needed. Raise used attacking IVs to 31 unless preserving Hidden Power requires 30; lower unused attacking IVs to 0 unless preserving Hidden Power requires 1. The Reset IVs tooltip includes the Doubles Trick Room team condition.
- Keep low IVs low when changing a Hidden Power type; use Showdown's standard Hidden Power IV pattern after the higher-priority costs tie. Reset IVs preserves the current Hidden Power type and still applies the unused/used attack and slow-Speed decisions.
- Preview bulk IV changes and skipped or locked spreads before applying drafts; never limit the plan to the currently visible pagination page.

## Invariants and pitfalls

- [pokemon-mechanics.mjs](../../../shared/pokemon-mechanics.mjs) and [spread-model.mjs](../../../shared/spread-model.mjs) are pure shared modules used by browser and server. Do not add browser or Node APIs to them.
- Do not confuse `spd`/`spdIv` with Sp. Def (`spDef`/`spDefIv`); Hidden Power parity order also places Speed before Sp. Atk and Sp. Def, unlike the stat table order.
- Do not force entered EVs to multiples of 4. The formula floors `ev / 4`; only arrow stepping follows multiples of 4. Existing invalid source values are displayed; validation blocks saving edited or added spreads rather than rewriting source on load.
- Do not infer IV use from move split alone: fixed-damage effects, Foul Play, Body Press, category-changing moves, and incomplete catalog details alter the answer. Unknown attacking use is not the same as unused use.
- `hiddenPowerIvs` is not a list of every parity-dependent field. It includes only changed fields that remain off the best auto-fix extreme; the preview labels come from that list.

## Tests

- Numeric-team regressions vary resolved enum IDs rather than assuming one value. Mechanics and suggestions compare numeric and symbolic behavior across all Hidden Power types, including explicit-preset priorities and no context leaks. Card tests cover numeric/symbolic Reset IVs, no-op disablement, current-field reset/reapplication and tooltip text. Editor tests cover numeric/symbolic All and IVs bulk preview/application and save payloads without team-field changes, while preserving independent EV behavior.
- [SpreadMechanics.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadMechanics.test.jsx) covers stat calculations at levels 5/50/100, Shedinja, Mega stats and abilities, natures, EV stepping and limits, ability slot ordering, all 16 Hidden Power types and Showdown IVs, move-use classification, IV auto-fix and reset (including move-free Trick Room teams and all Hidden Power types), and spread-model validation.
- [SpreadSuggestions.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadSuggestions.test.jsx) covers suggestion roles, Mega/ability/Choice/setup bias, mixed and slow natures, Body Press/fixed damage, all Hidden Power types, efficient level 5/50/100 EV allocations, safe disabling, catalog nature fallback, explicit presets/compatibility/slow IVs and immutability. It also covers move-free Trick Room team inference, Speed-lowering natures for every preset under slow moves/team requirements, retained explicit EV/IV priorities, strict slow-condition nature fallbacks and team Hidden Power preservation. [SpreadCard.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadCard.test.jsx) also covers suggestion application/placement/nature and EV labels, role tooltip, preset search/selection/application/automatic reset/cancellation and EV/IV column-wise Tab navigation.
- [SpreadCard.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadCard.test.jsx) covers the default Mega preview, editing switch, ability markers, stat controls, and Reset EVs/Reset IVs buttons. [SpreadEditor.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadEditor.test.jsx) covers bulk auto-fix preview and application, category labels, category-only application and EV toast, current-move IV preview/application, disabled empty category confirmation, move/IV/EV wording, category counts and bullet filtering, Hidden Power annotations, incremental lists, locked-source reasons, placeholder exclusion, and help tooltip hover/focus/click access. [SpreadLayout.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadLayout.test.jsx) covers independent category fields, current illegal attacking and slow-Speed moves, current Hidden Power preservation and unknown details for IV-only plans, per-stat EV caps, smallest non-maxed reductions and stat-order ties, maxed reductions only when needed, legal non-multiple-of-four Little Cup EVs and planner placeholder exclusion. [SpreadFilters.test.jsx](../../../src/tests/SpreadFilters.test.jsx) covers the toolbar controls.
- Run the focused mechanics suite with `$env:DEBUG_PRINT_LIMIT=0; yarn test src/tests/SpreadMechanics.test.jsx --run`. For UI changes, run the affected card, editor, or filter test file with the same command shape.

## Change checklist

1. Identify whether the rule belongs in the pure mechanics module, the spread model's entry/validation boundary, or a UI preview/control. Keep saved fields distinct from computed previews.
2. Check stat levels, nature rounding, EV budget and stepping, ability fallback, and Mega preview wherever the change touches them.
3. For IV changes, check every Hidden Power type, low IV preservation, unknown move details, used/unused attacking stats, Gyro Ball/Trick Room and move-free Doubles Trick Room teams, and the difference between a changed field and a Hidden Power annotation.
4. Update focused mechanics and UI tests for observable changes; run the narrowest relevant Yarn test command.
5. Update this skill when changing any behavior, files, signatures, or user decisions described here.
